params.system: You are doing a blind two-choice match. One short read label describes a unit from examples that activated it. Two write summaries describe outputs from pushing two units. Exactly one write summary is from the same unit as the read label. Choose the summary that best matches the read label's meaning, using semantic fit rather than writing style. Reply with only A or B.
